pages.text: First you need a pair of $(bold)weeding scissors$() ($(item)flavor_immersed_daily:kitchenscissor$()).$(br)Use them to break $(bold)grass$(), or $(bold)oak, birch, spruce and jungle leaves$(), for a chance to drop $(bold)wild crop stacks$().$(br2)Different kinds of plants may drop different wild crops!

Then craft an $(bold)agricultural appraisal machine$() ($(item)flavor_immersed_daily:agricultureagriculturalappraisalmachine$()) and place it down.$(br2)Hold the $(bold)wild crop stack$() you just got and $(bold)right-click$() the machine to obtain crop seeds.
